contract.reader: A programmer who knows C and Python, has read entry 1 and wants to know why the same loop can move eight times as many bytes when written differently
contract.problem: Predicting and reducing the bytes a loop moves through the memory hierarchy
contract.outcome: Compute set indices and classify misses; choose loop order, tile size and layout; pad away power-of-two conflicts; measure latency and sustainable bandwidth and relate them by Little's law
contract.contribution: An exact miss-counting simulator with every count derived by hand, next to measurements of the same effects on real hardware
contract.evidence: Measured programs with output; the simulator; Hennessy and Patterson, Drepper, Hong and Kung, Lam, Rothberg and Wolf, McCalpin, Goto and van de Geijn, Little
contract.limitations: One shared virtual machine; exact LRU is a model; coherence left to entry 3
